QUOTE: "**`tool:argpattern`** (has a colon): the part before the first colon is glob-matched against the tool name. The whole pattern is then glob-matched against `tool:argvalue`." and "**`tool`** (no colon): matches every call to that tool."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states fnmatch matching, a split at the first colon into tool and argument parts, and that a colon-less pattern matches on the tool name alone.
